new: 可以显示或收起侧栏；指向顶栏上的按钮时，会说明它是做什么的。
内置助手不再绑在总开关上。每个智能体可以单独设置启动参数和优先级。
性能监视器改到 Block 菜单里打开，并有了快捷键。
性能监视器可以拖动，会显示正在加载，统计笔记本占用时会跳过你设为忽略的文件夹。
笔记的修改建议会直接在编辑器里打开给你看，不再单独放一个审阅按钮。
选择智能体和启用它分成了两步，智能体卡片也更大。
improvements: 每次打开速记，它都单独待着，不再跟着主窗口绑在一起。
反馈的类型更少、说法更清楚，写完后顶部标题会收起。
常用控件重新画过，AI 对话看起来更简单。
挑选智能体时不会立刻启用，确认后才会保存。
编辑器里查看 AI 修改的卡片重新排过，不再出现空行。
AI 设置收成完整权限开关，以及后端实际提供的模型列表。
fixes: 对话框和下面的按钮对齐了，发送图标也更清楚。
新建的表格会适应页面宽度；整张表被选中时，可以把它删掉。
提示优先出现在按钮上方，靠近屏幕边缘时会挪开，避免被挡住。
在 macOS 上把笔记移到废纸篓不再因为权限失败；也可以把文件夹拖到侧栏来打开。
审阅卡片里的文字不再溢出；代码块两端的标记行不会被当成修改。
嵌套列表里的代码能正常显示；AI 给出的笔记修改会先检查，再写入。
other: 性能监视器的设计稿可以点着试用。
本地构建和发版构建走了更短的同一条流水线。
更新说明先写英文，下面再写中文。
发布页只放给人下载的安装包。
发布之后会再核对一遍，多出来的附件会被去掉。
本地构建不再在你没要求时重新打开 Block。
安装包固定为五个；手动强制构建时，也会带上自上一个版本以来的全部更新说明。
可以用 Linux 安装包给 Arch 用户发布。

new: You can show or hide the sidebar, and the title bar explains the control when you point at it.
The built-in assistant is no longer tied to one master switch. Each agent can have its own launch options and priority.
The performance monitor opens from the Block menu, and it has a shortcut.
The performance monitor can be dragged, shows a loading state, and skips folders you set to ignore when measuring the notebook.
A suggested change to a note opens in the editor for review, without a separate review button.
Choosing an agent is separate from turning it on, and the agent cards are larger.
improvements: Quick Note stays on its own each time you open it, instead of tying itself to the main window.
Feedback types are fewer and the wording is clearer, and the header hides when you finish.
Shared controls were redrawn, and AI chat is simpler to look at.
You can look through agents without turning one on, and the choice is saved when you confirm.
The card that reviews an AI change in the note was redesigned, and it no longer shows empty rows.
AI settings are a switch for full permissions and the model list the backend actually returns.
fixes: The chat box lines up with the buttons under it, and the send icon is sharper.
A new table fits the page, and selecting the whole table deletes it.
Tips prefer to appear above a control, and they move so they stay on screen.
Moving a note to the Trash on macOS no longer fails with a permission error, and you can drop a folder on the sidebar to open it.
Text in the review card stays inside the card, and the opening and closing lines of a code block are not shown as changes.
Code inside a nested list renders correctly, and an AI suggestion is checked before it changes the note.
other: The performance monitor design board can be clicked through.
Local builds and release builds now share a shorter pipeline.
Release notes are written in English first, with Chinese below.
The release page only keeps the installers people download.
After publishing, the release is checked again and extra files are removed.
A local build no longer restarts Block when you did not ask it to.
The release ships the five installers, and a forced build still gets notes for every commit since the previous release.
The Linux package can be published for Arch users.

new: AI 对话新增 Pi 后端，可在设置中选择显示哪些后端，智能体默认使用完整权限。
编辑器左上角新增大纲栏，悬停可查看标题，窄窗口下自动隐藏。
新增实时性能与存储监视器，用于查看应用运行状态与笔记本占用情况。
鼠标悬停在 AI 回复上时，右下角显示复制按钮。
improvements: AI 执行过程改为轻量文字展示，步骤默认折叠，并支持展开收起动画。
待确认的笔记修改计划可直接从对话中打开并在编辑器内审阅。
文件引用支持打开所在文件夹，并统一图标。
文件列表默认隐藏非 Markdown 文件，可在设置中调整。
调整设置页的关闭按钮和侧栏布局。
性能与存储信息改为统一卡片展示，笔记本占用单独列出。
macOS 主窗口与速记窗口可独立显示和隐藏，重新打开应用时显示主窗口。
fixes: 修复新建对话后输入框没有获得焦点的问题。
修复切换对话时可能卡顿的问题。
修复“关于”窗口打开时的菜单响应问题。
恢复粘贴 Markdown 内容时的格式识别，以及使用快捷键唤出隐藏主窗口的功能。
修复小窗口中斜杠菜单滚动时抖动的问题。
修复跨多个选中块添加批注或回应时的问题，多行内容保存在同一条记录中。
修复工具栏、级联菜单和弹出窗口的位置与边缘对齐问题。

new: Added Pi backend for AI chat, settings to choose visible backends, and default full agent permissions.
Added an outline bar in the top-left corner of the editor that displays headings on hover and automatically hides in narrow windows.
Added a real-time performance and storage monitor to view application activity and notebook disk usage.
Hovering over an AI response now displays a copy button in the bottom-right corner.
improvements: Streamlined the AI process view into lightweight text, with steps collapsed by default and animated expand and collapse.
Pending note modification plans can now be opened directly from chat into the editor for review.
File references now support opening the containing folder and use consistent icons.
The file list now hides non-Markdown files by default, which can be configured in settings.
Adjusted the settings page layout by updating the close button and simplifying the sidebar.
Consolidated performance and storage information into unified cards, with notebook storage listed separately.
The macOS main window and quick-note window can now be shown or hidden independently, and reopening the app displays the main window.
fixes: Fixed an issue where the input box did not gain focus after starting a new chat.
Fixed potential stutter when switching between chats.
Fixed menu responsiveness issues when opening the About window.
Restored Markdown formatting recognition when pasting content, and restored the shortcut to summon the hidden main window.
Fixed scrolling jitter in the slash menu within compact windows.
Fixed issues when adding annotations or reactions across multiple selected blocks, keeping multiline content in a single record.
Fixed positioning and edge alignment issues for toolbars, cascading menus, and popups.

new: implement scheme C unified agent deck, folio empty state, and fullscreen toggle。
simplify header, empty state capabilities, and composer controls。
replace disabled-state error banner with clickable enable cover。
Make the AI sidebar resizable with persistent width。
Clarify isolated in-app acceptance and computer-use boundaries。
Enable AI message selection and report interrupted responses。
fixes: Avoid redundant file opens and workspace traversal。
prevent agent deck layout jitter on selection and fit input placeholder。
anchor model picker beside its trigger。
Fix closing the last tab window without quitting on macOS。
Fix selected feedback chip text contrast in dark mode。
Fix chat composer multiline wrapping and bounded growth。

en.highlights: implement scheme C unified agent deck, folio empty state, and fullscreen toggle; simplify header, empty state capabilities, and composer controls.
new: implement scheme C unified agent deck, folio empty state, and fullscreen toggle.
simplify header, empty state capabilities, and composer controls.
replace disabled-state error banner with clickable enable cover.
Make the AI sidebar resizable with persistent width.
Clarify isolated in-app acceptance and computer-use boundaries.
Enable AI message selection and report interrupted responses.
fixes: Avoid redundant file opens and workspace traversal.
prevent agent deck layout jitter on selection and fit input placeholder.
anchor model picker beside its trigger.

Fix selected feedback chip text contrast in dark mode.

zh.highlights: 本次无面向用户的可见更新。

en.highlights: No user-facing changes in this release.

zh.highlights: 修复选择「下载或安装」类型时反馈可能提交失败的问题。
fixes: 修复选择「下载或安装」类型时反馈可能提交失败的问题。

en.highlights: Fixed feedback sometimes failing to send when the "Download or install" type was selected.
fixes: Fixed feedback sometimes failing to send when the "Download or install" type was selected.

zh.highlights: 笔记正文可以按比例缩放并记住，从速记回到主窗口时窗口会到前台；表格、代码块等块的上方也可以插入新段落。
new: 笔记正文可以按比例缩放并记住，从速记回到主窗口时窗口会到前台。
表格、代码块等块的上方也可以插入新段落。
improvements: 侧栏加宽后，搜索框可以完整显示。
行内代码不再弹出悬停提示。
复制行内代码后会立刻出现已复制的提示。
行内代码改成描边样式，光标走到边缘后可以继续移出。
设置页会显示当前版本号。
标签页不再显示文档小图标，顶栏更干净。
fixes: 窄侧栏里的搜索文字不再被截断。
速记里按下修饰键时，不再打断中文输入。
可以用原来的快捷键重新打开刚关掉的标签页。
切换浅色或深色时不再突然退出。
行内代码里划选文字时，选中范围不再高出文字。
窗口不在前台时，文字光标不再一直留在笔记上。

en.highlights: Note content can now be zoomed and remembered, and switching back from Quick Note brings the main window to the front. You can also insert a new paragraph directly above tables, code blocks, and other blocks.
new: Note content can now be zoomed and remembered, and switching back from Quick Note brings the main window to the front.
You can now insert a new paragraph directly above tables, code blocks, and other blocks.
improvements: The search box now shows completely when the sidebar is widened.
Inline code no longer shows a tip when you point at it.
Copying inline code now immediately shows a copied notification.
Inline code now uses an outlined style, and the cursor can move past its edges.
Settings now displays the current version number.
Tabs no longer show document icons, keeping the top bar cleaner.
fixes: Search text in a narrow sidebar is no longer cut off.
Pressing modifier keys in Quick Note no longer interrupts Chinese input.
You can now reopen recently closed tabs with the original shortcut.
Switching between light and dark mode no longer unexpectedly quits the app.
Highlighting text in inline code no longer extends above the text.
The text cursor no longer stays visible on notes when the window is in the background.
